name: com.rokid.rokit.kit.core.UniversalActivity
description: When a Rokid RoKit diagnostic or app-supplied custom page is opened full-screen, this Activity displays that page; a UI-stall alert also opens its monitor screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it blocks full-screen Rokid RoKit pages and any app feature launched through RoKit custom pages, and tapping a stall alert will not open its report.
